Removed "People commonly believe that candles last at most 10 hours." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "Adding fragrance at 65 degrees ensures the scent sets properly." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.

Removed "Most people think candles burn for 10 hours." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "The difference in burn time between soy wax candles and ordinary candles is that soy wax candles last longer." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "Our Lavender candle will burn for 40 hours." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "Candles are poured by hand in small batches, one by one." — Approved fact says 'Hand-poured in small batches' but does not specify 'one by one'.
Removed "The business takes no shortcuts." — No approved fact states this general claim about taking no shortcuts; absence of paraffin is one specific practice, not proof of no shortcuts overall.

Not on record: Does this candle use a lavender fragrance specifically chosen to support a sleep or bedtime routine? If so, please record the fragrance name or description against the Lavender candle product so the copy can say so truthfully.
Removed "The lavender candle will burn for 40 hours." — nothing on record can support a capability claim.

You asked for 500 happy customers. Your records say 2 paid orders and 1 lead on record — no record of 500 customers of any kind — change the record, or I write it without that.
Not on record: Total number of customers or orders to date — e.g. 'We have served X customers as of [date].'
Removed "For ₹999, you typically do not get a candle that burns for 40 hours." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "You will experience lavender's peace or rose's fragrance." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "You get a candle that burns for 40 hours at this price." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "The business ships to locations outside Shahjahanpur." — The business is in Shahjahanpur and shipping is free, but no record states which locations are shipped to. Location and cost do not establish coverage..
Not on record: Award-winning stylists: please record the specific award(s) won, the awarding body, and the year(s) — e.g. 'Won Best Stylist at [Award Name], [City], [Year].'
Not on record: everything — the business's records could not be read just now

Left out: The Bilona / hand-churned process is the hero differentiator for this ghee — lead with it. — it cites a record (e138f4eb) that does not exist.
Not on record: What animal / milk source is the ghee made from (e.g. A2 Gir cow milk)? Record it against product.desi_ghee_500ml.milk_source so the copy can state it.
Not on record: What quantity or batch size does the business produce? Record it against product.desi_ghee_500ml.batch_size if the owner wants to highlight small-batch production.
Not on record: Is there a specific city/area the business delivers to, or is delivery nationwide? Record it against shipping.coverage so the copy can set correct expectations.
Removed "No shortcuts are taken in making the desi ghee." — No fact states that no shortcuts are taken; facts about specific methods do not entail absence of shortcuts elsewhere..
Removed "Fresh paneer is made every morning." — No fact on record mentions paneer or when it is made; this product is not covered by any approved or recorded fact..

Not on record: The request asks for a claim that ghee is good for digestion. No record on file supports a digestion benefit for this product. Owner to record: 'Desi ghee 500ml supports digestion because [specific reason, e.g. contains butyric acid / Ayurvedic reference].' Once recorded, this can be cited.
Removed "If you have been putting off trying pure ghee because you are worried about weight, it is worth knowing that is a common misunderstanding about how good ghee actually works." — it says "pure", and nothing on record says that.
Removed "Pure ghee works in a way that contradicts the common misunderstanding about weight." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "A 250g quantity of paneer costs ₹120." — it states 120 ₹, and the figures on record are 850 inr.
Removed "Pure ghee will help you understand how good ghee actually works, addressing weight concerns." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "The business makes fresh paneer every morning." — No fact on either list states that the business makes paneer, fresh or otherwise, or that it makes anything every morning..
Removed "Paneer is sold in 250g quantities." — No fact on either list states that paneer is sold, or in what quantities..

Left out: Show the step-by-step process (hair wash first, then treatment) to build trust and set expectations. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Left out: Korean-sourced products signal quality and give the post a credible, specific detail. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: Does the business want to include a booking method (phone number, DM, WhatsApp link, or walk-in)? Please record the preferred call-to-action so the post can direct readers to act.
Not on record: Are there any before/after results or client testimonials the business wants to reference? Please record a specific, factual outcome (e.g. 'frizz reduced for X weeks') so it can be cited.
Removed "The salon does not use ammonia-containing products." — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "The business does not use anything containing ammonia." — Chosen fact states ammonia-free products are used, but this does not state that nothing containing ammonia is used — absence of one product type is not absence of all products with that ingredient..

Left out: Briefly describes the process step (wash then treatment) to give context around the session. — a process claim needs a record that can establish "process", and the one(s) cited cannot.
Not on record: How long does the keratin treatment result last on the hair (e.g. 'results last X weeks/months') — please record this against the Keratin treatment so it can be stated in copy.
Removed "The products used do not contain ammonia." — nothing on record can support a safety claim.
Removed "The time taken for keratin treatment is necessary because the work is done properly." — No fact states that the duration is necessary because work is done properly. Two facts (duration and quality) would need to be linked by a causal claim, which is not stated..

You asked for Ghee se weight nahi badhta (health/body claim). Your records say Koi bhi record yeh claim support nahi karta. Records mein sirf process, ingredients aur credentials hain — body ya weight ke baare mein kuch nahi. — change the record, or I write it without that.
Left out: Bilona method se bana ghee — process batana jo product ki authenticity dikhata hai — it cites a record (e138f4eb) that does not exist.
Not on record: Owner ko record karna chahiye: 'Desi ghee 500ml ke baare mein koi specific nutritional ya dietary fact jo hum claim kar sakein' — jaise fat type, calorie count, ya koi lab-tested property. Abhi koi aisa record nahi hai.
Removed "Most ghee sold in shops contains preservatives." — it compares with someone else's product, and nothing this business records about itself can establish that.
Removed "Ghee causes weight gain." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "If you have been avoiding ghee because you think it will cause weight gain, we are happy to talk about that, implying ghee will not cause weight gain." — nothing on record can support a benefit claim.
Removed "Shree Dairy's ghee contains no shortcuts in its making." — No fact states absence of shortcuts; 'no preservatives' and hand-churning do not entail no shortcuts overall..
Removed "Shree Dairy's ghee contains no additives." — Fact states 'no preservatives' but not 'no additives' — preservatives are one kind of additive, not all additives..
